ops.oldText: 7.2 Before engaging another provider, Customer must disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.
ops.newText: 7.2 Before engaging another provider, Customer need not disclose or match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.

ops.text: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation to Vendor.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have flipped the operator in Section 7.2 so we need not disclose or match a third-party offer, and confirmed that no most-favoured-nation obligation runs against us; our playbook does not accept an MFN or right-to-match burdening the Customer. This also aligns Section 7.2 with Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no most-favoured-customer commitment.
proposal.summary: Negate the Section 7.2 disclose-and-match obligation so Customer carries no MFN.
